words.definition: A network that transfers data or information very quickly between devices or systems.
words.example_en: The company installed a high-speed communication network to improve data transfer between offices.
words.example_sk: Spoločnosť nainštalovala vysokorýchlostnú komunikačnú sieť na zlepšenie prenosu dát medzi pobočkami.

words.definition: Computer-based systems used to monitor, control, and automate industrial processes and machinery.
words.example_en: Industrial control systems regulate temperature, pressure, and flow in modern engineering plants.
words.example_sk: Priemyselné riadiace systémy regulujú teplotu, tlak a prietok v moderných inžinierskych závodoch.

words.definition: Information or responses about the performance or result of a process, system, or design, used for improvement or control.
words.example_en: Feedback from the sensors ensures that the car engine runs smoothly.
words.example_sk: Spätná väzba zo snímačov zabezpečuje, aby motor automobilu bežal plynulo.

words.definition: The management of when, how, and under what conditions a function is executed within a system or program.
words.example_en: In embedded engineering, function execution control is essential to ensure that safety-critical tasks run at the correct time.
words.example_sk: V embedded inžinierstve je riadenie vykonávania funkcií nevyhnutné na to, aby sa úlohy kritické z hľadiska bezpečnosti vykonávali v správnom čase.

words.definition: Graphical programming diagrams used in industrial control and automation to represent logic similar to electrical relay circuits.
words.example_en: The automation engineer used ladder diagrams to program the PLC for the conveyor system.
words.example_sk: Automatizačný inžinier použil rebríkové diagramy na naprogramovanie PLC pre dopravníkový systém.

words.definition: Technical drawings that use standardized symbols to show the components and connections in an electrical circuit.
words.example_en: The engineer checked the electrical circuit diagrams before assembling the control panel.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval elektrické schémy obvodov pred zostavením ovládacieho panela.

words.definition: Fits or connects securely with another part by overlapping or engaging with it; also refers to mechanisms that prevent unsafe operation unless certain conditions are met.
words.example_en: Interlock refers to a safety mechanism that prevents a machine or process from operating unless certain predefined conditions are met.
words.example_sk: Pod pojmom „interlock“ sa rozumie bezpečnostný mechanizmus, ktorý zabraňuje prevádzke stroja alebo procesu, pokiaľ nie sú splnené určité vopred stanovené podmienky.

words.definition: Function Block Diagram networks used to connect and organize function blocks in control and automation engineering.
words.example_en: The engineer used FBD networks to design the logic for the automated production line.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil siete FBD na návrh logiky pre automatizovanú výrobnú linku.

words.definition: A function or operation that processes inputs, steps, or events in a specific fixed order, often with each stage depending on the previous one.
words.example_en: In the control system design, the sequential function activates each actuator in the required order to complete the assembly process safely.
words.example_sk: Pri návrhu riadiaceho systému sekvenčná funkcia aktivuje každý akčný člen v požadovanom poradí, aby sa montážny proces dokončil bezpečne.

words.definition: Graphs that show how signals or events change over time in an electronic or digital system.
words.example_en: The engineer checked the timing diagrams to verify that the control signals were synchronized correctly.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval časové diagramy, aby overil, že riadiace signály boli správne synchronizované.

words.definition: A diagram that shows the sequence of steps, decisions, or operations in a process or system.
words.example_en: The engineering team used a flow chart to map each stage of the manufacturing process.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím použil vývojový diagram na zmapovanie každej fázy výrobného procesu.

words.definition: Detailed additional directions or requirements provided to guide a technical or engineering task.
words.example_en: The technician followed the extended instructions to assemble the control panel correctly.
words.example_sk: Technik postupoval podľa rozšírených pokynov, aby správne zmontoval ovládací panel.

words.definition: Instruments, devices, or software used to identify faults, measure performance, or analyze the condition of a system or machine.
words.example_en: The engineers used diagnostic tools to detect a fault in the hydraulic system during testing.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri použili diagnostické nástroje na zistenie poruchy v hydraulickom systéme počas testovania.

words.definition: The process of testing and preparing a system, machine, or facility so it can begin operating correctly and safely.
words.example_en: The commissioning of the new production line included safety checks, calibration, and performance testing.
words.example_sk: Uvádzanie novej výrobnej linky do prevádzky zahŕňalo bezpečnostné kontroly, kalibráciu a výkonnostné testy.

words.definition: The maximum allowed rate of change of acceleration in a motion or control system.
words.example_en: The engineer reduced the jerk limit in the CNC machine to achieve smoother motion and protect the mechanical components.
words.example_sk: Inžinier znížil limit trhnutia v CNC stroji, aby dosiahol plynulejší pohyb a chránil mechanické súčiastky.

words.definition: The process of guiding a device, vehicle, or signal toward a target or a fixed location automatically.
words.example_en: The missile uses radar homing to track the target accurately.
words.example_sk: Raketa používa radarové navádzanie na presné sledovanie cieľa.

words.definition: Electronic units or components that enable devices or systems to send, receive, and process data signals.
words.example_en: The engineer installed communications modules in the control system to allow remote monitoring of the machine.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nainštaloval komunikačné moduly do riadiaceho systému, aby umožnil vzdialené monitorovanie stroja.

words.definition: A temporary storage area used in engineering systems to hold diagnostic data before it is processed, transmitted, or analyzed.
words.example_en: The control unit writes sensor fault codes to the diagnostic buffer before sending them to the maintenance interface.
words.example_sk: Riadiaca jednotka zapisuje chybové kódy snímačov do diagnostickej vyrovnávacej pamäte pred ich odoslaním do servisného rozhrania.

words.definition: Recorded sets of information collected and stored by a system for monitoring, analysis, or troubleshooting.
words.example_en: The engineer reviewed the data logs from the control system to identify the cause of the equipment failure.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval dátové záznamy z riadiaceho systému, aby zistil príčinu poruchy zariadenia.

words.definition: To install a newer version of the permanent software that controls a device or machine.
words.example_en: The engineer had to update the firmware on the controller to improve the robot's performance.
words.example_sk: Inžinier musel aktualizovať firmvér v riadiacej jednotke, aby zlepšil výkon robota.

words.definition: Additional items or components used with a machine, device, or system to improve its function or suitability.
words.example_en: The engineer ordered several accessories for the control panel, including mounting brackets and cable covers.
words.example_sk: Inžinier objednal niekoľko kusov príslušenstva pre ovládací panel vrátane montážnych konzol a krytov káblov.

words.definition: The exchange of technical service information or support data between distant systems or locations through communication networks.
words.example_en: The engineering team used teleservice communication to diagnose the fault in the remote control unit without visiting the site.
words.example_sk: Inžiniersky tím použil komunikáciu teleservisu na diagnostiku poruchy v vzdialenej riadiacej jednotke bez návštevy pracoviska.

words.definition: A signal input that receives continuously varying electrical values from sensors or other devices.
words.example_en: The temperature sensor was connected to the analog input of the control unit to monitor the machine during testing.
words.example_sk: Teplotný snímač bol pripojený k analógovému vstupu riadiacej jednotky na monitorovanie stroja počas testovania.

words.definition: Components or units in an engineering system that generate, process, transmit, or control signals.
words.example_en: The control panel uses signal modules to process sensor data from the production line.
words.example_sk: Ovládací panel používa signálové moduly na spracovanie údajov zo senzorov na výrobnej linke.

words.definition: Devices that allow humans to interact with and control machines or industrial systems through displays, buttons, touchscreens, or other interfaces.
words.example_en: Modern HMI devices let engineers monitor production lines and adjust machine settings in real time.
words.example_sk: Moderné zariadenia HMI umožňujú inžinierom sledovať výrobné linky a upravovať nastavenia strojov v reálnom čase.

words.definition: A mobile communication system based on the Global System for Mobile Communications standard.
words.example_en: The remote monitoring unit sends maintenance data through the GSM network to the control center.
words.example_sk: Diaľková monitorovacia jednotka posiela údaje o údržbe cez sieť GSM do riadiaceho centra.

words.definition: The regulation of the movement and rate of liquids, gases, or data through a system.
words.example_en: The engineer adjusted the valve to improve flow control in the cooling system.
words.example_sk: Inžinier upravil ventil, aby zlepšil riadenie prietoku v chladiacom systéme.

words.definition: An instruction or command that specifies the speed and direction of movement of a machine, component, or system.
words.example_en: The robot controller sent a velocity instruction to the motor drive to adjust the conveyor speed.
words.example_sk: Riadiaca jednotka robota poslala pohonu motora pokyn pre rýchlosť, aby upravila rýchlosť dopravníka.

words.definition: A device or circuit that counts pulses or events occurring at a very high rate in an engineering system.
words.example_en: The PLC uses a high-speed counter to measure the encoder pulses from the motor shaft accurately.
words.example_sk: PLC používa vysokorýchlostné počítadlo na presné meranie impulzov z enkódera na hriadeli motora.

words.definition: Basic processes in digital engineering that manipulate binary values according to logical rules, such as AND, OR, and NOT.
words.example_en: In digital engineering, logic operations are used to control how signals are processed in a circuit.
words.example_sk: V digitálnom inžinierstve sa logické operácie používajú na riadenie toho, ako sa signály spracúvajú v obvode.

words.definition: An action performed on a text string in computing, such as joining, splitting, searching, or modifying characters.
words.example_en: String operations are commands and methods used in computer programming to manipulate or transform text strings.
words.example_sk: Operácie s reťazcami sú príkazy a metódy používané v programovaní na manipuláciu s textovými reťazcami alebo ich transformáciu.

words.definition: An event that occurs independently of the main program flow and is handled when it happens rather than in a fixed sequence.
words.example_en: In the control software, an asynchronous event from the sensor triggered an immediate safety response.
words.example_sk: V riadiacom softvéri asynchrónna udalosť zo senzora spustila okamžitú bezpečnostnú reakciu.

words.definition: Stops a process, signal, or activity for a short time so something else can happen.
words.example_en: Hardware interrupts are those interrupts that are caused by any peripheral device by sending a signal through a specified pin to the microprocessor.
words.example_sk: Hardvérové prerušenia sú prerušenia, ktoré vyvoláva akékoľvek periférne zariadenie odoslaním signálu cez určený vývod do mikroprocesora.

words.definition: The byte in a multi-byte binary number that contains the highest-value bits.
words.example_en: In the 32-bit register, the most significant byte stores the highest-order bits of the sensor data.
words.example_sk: V 32-bitovom registri najvýznamnejší bajt uchováva bity s najvyššou hodnotou zo senzorových údajov.

words.definition: The byte in a multi-byte data value that contains the lowest-order bits and represents the smallest part of the value.
words.example_en: In the embedded engineering project, the least significant byte of the sensor reading was transmitted first over the serial interface.
words.example_sk: V projekte embedded inžinierstva sa cez sériové rozhranie najprv prenášal najmenej významný bajt zo snímača.

words.definition: The process of setting a system, device, or program to its starting state so it can begin operating correctly.
words.example_en: During the initialization of the control system, the engineer checked all sensor inputs and default parameters.
words.example_sk: Počas inicializácie riadiaceho systému inžinier skontroloval všetky vstupy zo senzorov a predvolené parametre.
